name: Charge
description: Charge at an opponent, doubling your movement rate, +2 to Attack Roll, -2 to your AC this turn.

name: Haste
description: Haste grants +1 to attack rolls and one extra attack at your highest base attack bonus during a full attack. Movement is also increased.

modifiers.label: One extra attack during a full attack

name: Bard Song
description: Bardic music inspires allies: +2 to attack rolls and +2 to damage rolls.
